name: Hexagonal Crystal
description: v1's Hexagonal Crystal (Experiments 1): 448 neutral atoms (6 up + 6 down quarks, 2 electrons) on the vertices of a honeycomb, nuclear charge alternating ±1 around each hexagon, under v1's powAX nuclear force (pull below 0.25 of the 1000 range, push beyond) and Coulomb, inside a reflecting circle of radius 5e4. Gravity (G = 1e-3) is negligible and omitted.
